capture.docs: This action will start capturing audio data from the microphone. The data will be passed to any components listening and will be available in the `on_data` trigger.

mute.docs: This action will apply a software mute to the audio data from the microphone before passing it to any listening components.

stop_capture.docs: This action will stop capturing audio data from the microphone.

unmute.docs: This action will disable applying a software mute initiated with `microphone.mute`.

is_capturing.docs: This condition will check if the microphone is currently capturing audio data.

is_muted.docs: This condition will check if the microphone is currently apply a software mute.

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The microphone to check. Defaults to the only one in YAML.

*See also: [Microphone Components](https://esphome.io/components/microphone#microphoneon_data-trigger)*

bits_per_sample.docs:
**int**: The bits per sample to use as input to the component. May be restricted by the component to a specific value.

*See also: [Microphone Components](https://esphome.io/components/microphone#base-microphone-configuration)*

on_data.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform when new data is received.

*See also: [Microphone Components](https://esphome.io/components/microphone#base-microphone-configuration)*
